tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I found a genuine ambiguity that I don't want to resolve by guessing, since payments are irreversible.

**Fjord Analytics (V-410)** — bank verified, supports wire and ACH. Details:

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-30103 | $4,332.36 | **approved** | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-50292 | $5,384.89 | **approved** | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-59460 | $4,391.78 | paid | 2026-09-30 |
| INV-91213 | $7,010.11 | draft (awaiting approval) | 2026-11-28 |

There are **two** approved invoices, and your request referred to "the approved invoice" in the singular. I've also confirmed no payments have been sent yet from the operating account, so nothing is at risk of double-payment.

I did **not** make a payment, because:
- Paying both would be a $9,717.25 disbursement you didn't authorize.
- Paying the wrong one would need to be clawed back.
- INV-91213 is still a draft (not approved), so it's excluded regardless.

**Which invoice should I pay?**
- **INV-30103** ($4,332.36) — the earlier due date, if you mean the one currently due soonest
- **INV-50292** ($5,384.89)

Both are under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold, so once you confirm, I can wire it immediately with no additional approval step. (Wire is available for this vendor, so I'll use wire as you preferred — no need to fall back to ACH.) I'll use an idempotency key and verify against the payment list afterward to confirm it was sent exactly once.

trace.message: Pay INV-50292, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.
